title: Single sign-on
description: Link your account to your company identity provider.
needPassword: Set a password before unlinking, otherwise you could not sign in.
admin.title: Single sign-on
admin.description: Let people sign in with your OpenID Connect identity provider. Passwords keep working.
admin.adminOnly: Only administrators can configure single sign-on.
admin.error: The configuration could not be loaded.
admin.noKey: PMS_SSO_KEY is not set on this server, so a client secret cannot be stored. Ask the operator to set it.
admin.redirect: Redirect URI to register at your provider
admin.redirectHint: Use exactly this address as the redirect (callback) URI of the application you create there.
admin.name: Button name
admin.secretKept: A secret is stored; leave empty to keep it
admin.domainsHint: Comma separated. Empty allows any domain.
admin.autoLinkHint: A first sign-in is linked to the active user with the same verified email. People who are not users here are never created.
admin.saveFailed: The configuration could not be saved.
admin.removeDescription: The sign-in button disappears and all linked identities are forgotten. Passwords keep working.
saml.title: SAML 2.0
saml.description: Let people sign in with a SAML identity provider. Passwords keep working.
saml.hint: Give these to your identity provider's administrator, or import the metadata address. Responses must be signed; encrypted assertions and provider-initiated sign-in are not supported. Sign-in needs HTTPS.
saml.noMetadata: The stored metadata cannot be read. Paste it again.
saml.metadataHint: Paste the whole EntityDescriptor. It holds the provider's sign-on address and signing certificate. The stored copy is never shown; leave this empty to keep it.
saml.attributeHint: Name of the attribute that carries the email. Empty tries email, mail and the usual claim names, then an email-format NameID.
